messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: RAmazonS3 on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi All,

I was trying to deploy an with dependence on RAmazonS3. I received the following:

Waiting for task: 28025
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building package: xtable (1.7-1)
  building: Building package: plyr (1.8)
  building: Building package: bitops (1.0-6)
  building: Building package: caTools (1.16)
  building: Building package: digest (0.6.4)
  building: Building package: XML (3.98-1.1)
  building: Building package: Rcompression (0.94-0)
  building: Building package: RCurl (1.95-4.1)
  building: Building package: RAmazonS3 (0.1-4)
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 28026 error: Unhandled Exception: Error building RAmazonS3 (0.1-4). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

On a local server running ubuntu 12.04 I needed to do the following:

sudo apt-get install libdigest-hmac-perl

Then RAmazonS3 installed. Is it possible to have this package on shinyapps.io

Regards

John
